public_rationale: Contemporary reporting places OpenAI at the first level of its own scale, approaching the second. Bloomberg also reports that AGI systems did not yet exist. This supports the claim as a description of OpenAI's publicly reported position in July 2024. The reported reasoning demonstration does not establish advancement to level 2.
limitations: The classification is self-reported and conveyed through news reporting.
Support concerns the contemporary classification, not a universal scientific test of AGI.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI has not developed AGI and has not moved past the first, chatbot stage of its own five-level scale.

statement.excerpt: Pre-AGI in this case refers to anything OpenAI has ever developed, as it has yet to develop AGI and has yet to get past the initial "chatbot" stage of its own 5-level system of evaluating artificial intelligence.

from_speaker: has yet to get past the initial "chatbot" stage
our_interpretation: Assess OpenAI's position at the time of the post, not capabilities developed afterward.
Use July 2024 through the post date as the latest reporting period for this ongoing state.
Read the statement against OpenAI's own classification and the contemporary meaning of AGI, rather than imposing a new benchmark.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous reporting places OpenAI below level 2 on its own scale and reports that AGI had not been achieved.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that OpenAI had achieved AGI or advanced beyond level 1 by the post date.
